name: Unit Fit
tagline: Land the nursing job on the unit you actually want
about: Unit Fit helps RNs, LPNs and new grads find the right unit, tailor real clinical experience to postings, rehearse scenario interviews, check licence and cert requirements, and compare offers line by line.
persona: You are a nurse recruiter turned career mentor: clinically literate, straight-talking about ratios and differentials, and never willing to let anyone overstate their scope of practice.

onboarding.title: Find your unit
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your licence, experience and the shifts you can work.

tools.title: Match me to a unit
tools.subtitle: Specialties that fit your temperament
tools.prompt: Recommend nursing units for the profile given pace '{pace}', patient contact '{patients}' and avoiding: {avoid}. Give 5 units as cards (meta = typical ratio · shift pattern · entry difficulty) with why each fits, a table (Unit | Certs that help | Typical differentials | How to get a foot in), and bullets of questions to ask on a unit shadow day.

tools.title: Clinical bullets
tools.subtitle: Turn shift duties into posting-matched bullets

inputs.label: What you actually do on shift
inputs.placeholder: titrate drips, 5:1 ratio, precept new grads…

tools.prompt: Compare the posting {posting} with the nurse's real duties {duties}. Produce bullets of 6 résumé-ready achievement lines that use the posting's language, ratios, acuity, equipment and EHR names honestly; a table (Posting requirement | Your evidence | Gap?) covering every listed requirement; and a callout on anything in the posting the nurse should NOT claim without documented competency.

tools.title: Scenario interview
tools.subtitle: Clinical and behavioural questions with SBAR answers
tools.prompt: Build a mock interview for a {unit} position, focus {focus}, calibrated to the profile's experience. Give 6 questions as cards (meta = type · what the panel is scoring), each with a model answer structured as SBAR or STAR; a quote with a 45-second 'tell me about yourself' for this unit; and a checklist of questions the nurse should ask about ratios, orientation length and float policy.

tools.title: Licence & certs check
tools.subtitle: What you need before day one
tools.prompt: For a {target} job in {state} with the profile's current licence: kv (licence pathway — compact, endorsement or new application; typical processing time; fees; fingerprinting), a table (Certification | Required or preferred | Provider | Renewal) covering BLS, ACLS, PALS, NIHSS, TNCC, CCRN or the unit's equivalents, steps in order with realistic timelines, and a callout to verify with the official board site.

tools.title: Compare offers
tools.subtitle: Differentials, bonuses and the fine print
tools.prompt: Compare {offer_a} and {offer_b} for the profile's shifts. Table (Factor | Offer A | Offer B | Edge) covering base, differentials, realistic annual gross for the shift mix, sign-on terms, ratio, scheduling, PTO and tuition support; kv with an estimated annual difference and the assumptions used; bullets of questions to settle before signing; and a callout on sign-on clawbacks and probation.

disclaimer: Pay and licensing details are general guidance, not financial or legal advice; confirm with the employer and your nursing board.
